manufacturer CAD, joint limits, port dimensions, fastener torque
physical optical propagation and fluid/biological processes: not modeled
actual hardware controls and live software: not connected
global_rules: all observed scientific images/readings are labeled source_reference or authored_preset
unknown values are null or named inputs, never filled from unscaled photographs
numerical optical examples are provenance facts, not validated robot setpoints
clinical/pathogenic/weaponizable biological agents and constructing new reporter strains are outside this design
routine specimen handling is represented explicitly; hazardous historical practices are substituted transparently
a safe rejection or blocked input is an honest terminal outcome, not experiment success
context.source_version: Green OA NIH/HHS author accepted manuscript; NOT publisher version of record

items.gap: Positive predicates describe successful routes only; state revocation, resource consumption, recovery and version-invalidation engines are not implemented. Source and task recovery constraints written in prose require separate validation in a future implementation.

Partial time series must be retained and honestly reported. E010 and D001 currently start the complete-series success route; a separate machine-readable interrupted-archive/safe-closeout route remains unimplemented and cannot be bypassed with success predicates.
D-R01 has a separate actor-goal draft; other routes have author-reference templates only. Safe loading and test isolation are not implemented.
Timepoint manifests, numeric tolerances, observable fault responses, instance cards and preset images still require explicit authoring; missing inputs must not be guessed.
All 37 asset classes are requirements; physical geometry, robot reachability, grasp/connection interfaces and optical responses have not been implemented or validated.

hidden_from_agent: numeric success gates chosen by benchmark authors
acceptance.numerical_result_policy: Evaluate task procedure and evidence, without requiring reproduction of the paper's FWHM, duration, embryo development or cell results. All images/readings are clearly labeled authored presets, not actual measurements.

context.coverage: All main steps 1–95 + 96A(i–xxiv) + 97–106, plus reagent/equipment setup and authored cleanup; the cell and custom launch alternatives are separately specified in the full family.
context.authored_sequence_note: The sequence is newly authored task topology, not a verbatim source copy. Every operation remains subject to its preconditions; diagnostic loops may return to relevant checkpoints.
